design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (consumer_credit_servicing, card). Step 0 draw: `draw_counts.py <DIFF> --task 0` -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 4]}; card_ext_refund_credit takes 4 factors, card_ext_promo_autopay takes 4. --tasks 2 shows task 1 also draws 1 prerequisite and [4, 4].
SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Occupied before: nothing. Claimed here: card_ext_refund_credit (card_return_credit_posted, agent tool post_refund_return_credit_59e816eb) and card_ext_promo_autopay (card_autopay_changed, user tool set_autopay_payoff_plan_7f80aff1). Reserved for task 1 with independent load-bearing space: the late fee (card_fee_assessed) and the cardholder's one-time phone payment (card_payment_posted), a different subject pair, different tools and a different customer and tier (Premier). Dispute credits, fee reversals, waivers, credit-limit changes and closures stay unclaimed by design (no computation the DSL can carry with four load-bearing factors was found for them).
WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer asks only for autopay at a fixed amount that pays off her 12-month cabinet promotion. The plan amount depends on the deferred-interest balance, and the plan policy says it is not worked out until every selling-program refund to the card stands as a return credit. The world hides a 363.00 vendor-delay refund issued by the special order program on 2026-09-24 that never reached the card, so the agent must read the special order ledger (another difficulty), post the return credit with its own four-factor allowance, and only then compute the plan. Difficulty is policy reading + ledger reconciliation + tiered arithmetic, never tool guessing: each problem has exactly one tool.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root card_ext_promo_autopay <- card_ext_refund_credit. Edge kind value_input, gate promo_credits, form state, policy_source: "The plan's fixed draft amount is not worked out until every special order refund issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name in the last 3 months stands on the account as a return credit." Four-point test: connective 'not ... until' (negated direction; a plan that waits on an outstanding item is naturally put that way); waits on a record-visible state (a return credit standing for each refund); no tool, id or code token; scope 'every special order refund issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name in the last 3 months' = the edge condition and the refund-credit compute window (round-2 fix O-5). Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: posting a return credit (the late fee and the phone payment do not create return credits). Derivation: sentence + records (refund row special_order_events refund_method ridgeline_consumer_credit 363.00 on 2026-09-24, no matching card return credit; the only card return credit is 58.40 on 2026-04-02) + the refund-credit rule ('one return credit is posted for it, referencing the purchase the refund credits') -> the return-credit write. Owner: agent for the credit, user (the cardholder in person) for the autopay. Topological order: step 7 then step 9. Deletion sensitivity (run): skipping step 7 gives 2696.00 instead of 2499.00. user_scenario mentions no refund or credit; tools block nothing (bodies only ctx.create/ctx.update).
FACTOR CARD card_ext_refund_credit (baseline 364.07). allowance_rate (parameter; tier and tenure, both read off the account row, so not counted as multi-source): Preferred open 67 months -> purchase APR 29.99; baseline 6 percent -> 380.50. late_posting_clock (method, cross-difficulty special, multi-source: delay-credit total vs card-tender refund total): the 363.00 delay credits of the window equal the 363.00 card-tender refund, so the refund is the payout of that delay credit -> 21 days from the delay credit of 2026-09-21; baseline from refund date 18 days -> 388.74; near-miss: an order-cancellation credit of 2026-09-08 on the bank-card window-covering order (the delay tier wins, and its bank_card refund of 495.00 is excluded from the uncredited refund by tender). flat_courtesy (parameter): 18 days since refund, 14-29 band -> 7.50; baseline none -> 375.52. allowance_multiplier (parameter): special-order card purchases in 12 months 7260.00 >= 5000 -> 2; baseline 1 -> 376.76. Result 390.52.
FACTOR CARD card_ext_promo_autopay (baseline 1670.00). plan_horizon (method: each tier transforms the due-date count differently - halved and rounded up / times 0.75 and rounded down / taken whole): late fee 2026-03-12 within 12 months, no returned payment -> int(3 x 0.75) = 2 drafts; baseline all 3 -> 1696.00. plan_margin (parameter; tier and tenure from the account row): Preferred 67 months >= 36 -> 1 percent; baseline 5 -> 2594.00. spending_addon (parameter): standard purchases in 3 months 1026.75 -> 40.00 (near-miss: 212.30 on 2026-07-10 is exactly 3 months back and excluded); baseline 0 -> 2459.00. open_order_cushion (parameter, cross-difficulty special): countertop SO-0418-571394 in_production balance_due 1240.00 -> 50.00; baseline 0 -> 2449.00. Result 2499.00.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Step 7 subject card_return_credit_posted governed by card_evt_return_credit: creditable_status (status active, card_accounts row) holds; refund_requested applies only to credit balance refunds. Overwrite declared: 'The credit amount is the refund decided under the selling program's own rules' is replaced by the uncredited-refund-plus-allowance sentence; the cap clause (credits never exceed the purchase amount: 390.52 << 7260.00) stays inherited. Step 9 subject card_autopay_changed governed by card_autopay_management: cardholder_instruction (the cardholder runs the tool herself, identifying the card by its digits 4471 from the persona) and open_account (active). No time gate on either write; the autopay lead rule is met because the first plan due date 2026-11-09 is weeks away.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target of step 7: the deferred_12 purchase fca127cf (7260.00, SO-0418-552063); the refund row references the special payment of that order; excluded: the bank_card refund of SO-0418-560871 and the old in-store credit. Target of step 9: the card account c7d14210 (last4 4471).
SEED. Ledger starts at zero in 2026-01: promo purchase, standard purchases, the missed February minimum and its 32.00 late fee, the March catch-up payment, autopay minimum drafts on each due date, two extra payments recorded deferred_promo_requested (1200.00, 900.00), statements Feb-Sep recomputed with the Preferred minimum formula; current_balance 4982.80 = sum of deltas. Special order ledger: cabinetry (completed; 363.00 delay credit and its refund to the card tender), window coverings (cancelled, refunded to bank_card), countertop (in production, balance due 1240.00). No row ignites another obligation: no statement is past due at 2026-10-12, the 2026-10-09 draft covered the September minimum.
PERSONA. Brisk librarian; volunteers the goal, the phone number; ZIP and DOB on request, SSN last four only if a third detail is asked; card ending 4471, order number and bank account ending 3906 only when asked; passive go-ahead if told something must be put right first; insists on entering the autopay change herself; closes after the fixed amount is confirmed. No prerequisite named.
STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(phone) -> verify(zip, dob) -> find_card_accounts -> find_card_transactions -> find_special_orders -> find_special_order_events -> unlock+call post_refund_return_credit_59e816eb(amount 390.52, plan deferred_12, reference SO-0418-552063, original purchase fca127cf) -> unlock_user + call_user set_autopay_payoff_plan_7f80aff1(card 4471, 2499.00).
VERIFICATION RUN (inline runner replaying gold writes with the real tools, then cc.build_env/eval_compute per computation): card_ext_refund_credit result 390.52 baseline 364.07 factors allowance_rate 380.5, late_posting_clock 388.74, flat_courtesy 375.52, allowance_multiplier 376.76; card_ext_promo_autopay result 2499.0 baseline 1670.0 factors plan_horizon 1696.0, plan_margin 2594.0, spending_addon 2459.0, open_order_cushion 2449.0; prerequisite skip: 2696.0. Gates --task 0: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
REVISIONS. (1) Autopay drafts first simulated on the next business day produced spurious late fees -> drafts moved onto the due date as the base autopay rule states, seed regenerated. (2) A module helper was read by the gate as a task tool -> inlined. (3) The cardholder_instruction gate binds a caller-stated value to the account argument, so the user tool identifies the card by the last four digits the cardholder holds instead of an internal id.
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the rule prose alone: uncredited 363.00, rate APR, 21 days, 7.50, x2 -> 390.52; then 7260.00 - 390.52 - 2100.00 = 4769.48, 2 drafts, 1 percent, ceil 2409 + 40 + 50 = 2499.00; agrees with gold.
ROUND 2 REWORK (audit env/env_0046_home_improvement_retailer/audits/policy_task/consumer_credit_servicing/, task 0 SOURCE-FACTOR RED). F-1 symptom: allowance_multiplier labelled method but its tiers only swap 2 / 1.5 / 1 into one expression -> root cause: a value factor mislabelled -> change: effect parameter, ladder values K('mult_high') / K('mult_mid') / 1 -> card_ext_refund_credit now 3 parameter + 1 method (late_posting_clock). F-2 symptom: plan_horizon tiers were n-2 / n-1 / n, one formula with a constant, so card_ext_promo_autopay had no honest method -> change: tier 1 halves the due-date count and rounds up, tier 2 multiplies it by 0.75 and rounds down, the fall-through takes it whole (a transform whose operation and rounding direction differ by tier); on this world int(3 x 0.75) = 2, the same draft count, so gold stays 2499.00 and the factor still bears weight (baseline 1696.00). F-3 symptom: the clock tiers ranged over any special order's delay or cancellation credit -> change: a tier holds only when the credits of that type applied in the 3-month window total exactly the card-tender refunds of the window, i.e. when the refund is the payout of that credit (compute XSUM of the credit type compared with prog_refunds); the bank-card window-covering cancellation (495.00) no longer qualifies on amount; gold stays 390.52. O-5: the prerequisite sentence now names exactly the special order refunds to the card tender in the last 3 months, the state its condition and the refund-credit window use. Rationale's false multi-source claims for allowance_rate and plan_margin corrected. Re-run (inline runner): card_ext_refund_credit 390.52, baseline 364.07, factors 380.5 / 388.74 / 375.52 / 376.76; card_ext_promo_autopay 2499.0, baseline 1670.0, factors 1696.0 / 2594.0 / 2459.0 / 2449.0; prerequisite skip 2696.0 - all unchanged.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs the customer_id; without the profile no account can be found.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record in-session identity verification with two stated credentials (billing ZIP 60540, date of birth 1983-07-26).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Account information and any account change require the caller to be verified first (share tool contract).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her consumer credit accounts: the Preferred card's variant, opened_date (2021-02-17), current_balance and autopay settings.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the card_account_id both writes target, the tier and tenure that decide the allowance rate and the plan margin, and the autopay option being replaced.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies every card-side input: promo_posted/promo_payments, posted_credits in the 3-month window, the late fee for the plan horizon, recent standard purchases for the add-on, special-order spend for the multiplier, and the latest due date that starts the plan's due dates.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her special orders: cabinetry SO-0418-552063 (completed), window coverings SO-0418-560871 (cancelled) and countertop SO-0418-571394 (in_production, balance_due 1240.00).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The open-order cushion is decided from the balance due on orders in production, shipped or ready, and the order numbers tie the refund to the card purchase it credits.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the prerequisite is unmet (a card-tender refund with no return credit on the card) and supplies the uncredited refund, the refund date and the delay-credit date that starts the late-posting clock.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for an agent write; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Post the 390.52 return credit to the Preferred card against the cabinetry purchase, plan deferred_12, reference SO-0418-552063.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The plan policy states its amount is not worked out until every program refund stands on the account as a return credit; card_ext_refund_credit's compute uniquely yields 390.52.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.card_account_id: Value c7d14210-ed1d-443e-b10d-4a0a82b8911b. Basis: the docstring says 'the reference number of the consumer credit account (card or project loan) that paid for the original purchase, as returned by the account lookup', and the card ledger shows purchase SO-0418-552063 on this account. Uniqueness: she holds one consumer credit account, returned by find_card_accounts at step 2.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.original_transaction_id: Value fca127cf-19b7-47e6-8ceb-f881d84be501. Basis: the refund-credit rule says the credit is posted 'referencing the purchase the refund credits'; the special order refund refers to the 7260.00 card payment of order SO-0418-552063, and the card ledger's card_purchase_posted row with merchant_reference SO-0418-552063 is this id. Uniqueness: it is the only card purchase carrying that order number.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.merchant_reference: Value SO-0418-552063. Basis: the rule says the credit carries 'the order number of the refund'; special_order_events refund row order_number = SO-0418-552063 (step 5). Uniqueness: the only refund to the card tender belongs to this order; the other refund (SO-0418-560871) went to a bank card.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.plan_code: Value deferred_12. Basis: the rule says the credit carries 'that purchase's plan code', and the referenced purchase row has plan_code deferred_12. Uniqueness: revolving_standard, deferred_6, deferred_24, fixed_apr_84 and loan_draw are other plans the purchase does not carry; not_applicable never applies to a return credit per the docstring.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 390.52. uncredited refund = 363.00 (card-tender special refunds in 3 months 363.00 - return credits in 3 months 0.00); allowance rate 29.99 (Preferred, 67 months open >= 60 -> purchase APR); late-posting days 21 (the delay credits of the window, 363.00, total exactly the card-tender refunds, so the clock starts at the 2026-09-21 delay credit); interest allowance RND(363.00 x 29.99/100 x 21/365, 2) = 6.26; flat courtesy 7.50 (18 days since the refund, 14-29 band); multiplier 2 (special-order card purchases in 12 months 7260.00 >= 5,000.00); allowance RND((6.26 + 7.50) x 2, 2) = 27.52; credit = 363.00 + 27.52 = 390.52.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the hidden autopay-plan tool so the cardholder can run it herself.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Autopay changes are made only on the cardholder's own instruction; the customer's own write must be unlocked and handed over.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Odalys enrols her card in autopay with the fixed draft amount 2499.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: card_ext_promo_autopay's compute, evaluated after the return credit lands, uniquely yields 2499.00; this is the root problem she called about.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.card_account_id: Value 4471. Basis: the docstring asks for 'the last four digits of the account number printed on the card ... as the cardholder states it', and the persona says 'it is the Preferred card ending 4471'; card_accounts.account_last4 = 4471 on her only card. Uniqueness: she holds one card account, and these are its digits.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.autopay_fixed_amount: Value 2499.00. deferred-interest balance = 7260.00 posted - 390.52 return credit on deferred_12 (step 7) - 2100.00 payments recorded deferred_promo_requested = 4769.48; plan end 2027-01-19; due dates after today through the end: 2026-11-09, 2026-12-09, 2027-01-09 = 3; drafts = int(3 x 0.75) = 2 (late fee 2026-03-12 within 12 months, no returned payment: due dates times 0.75, rounded down); margin 1 percent (Preferred open 67 months >= 36); ceil(4769.48 x 1.01 / 2) = 2409; spending add-on 40.00 (standard purchases in 3 months 1026.75 >= 500.00); open-order cushion 50.00 (countertop order in production with balance due 1240.00 >= 1,000.00); 2409 + 40 + 50 = 2499.00.

factor_trace: allowance_rate (parameter): card_accounts.c7d14210-ed1d-443e-b10d-4a0a82b8911b.variant_name = Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred and opened_date 2021-02-17 gives MONTHS to 2026-10-12 = 67 >= 60, so the tier 'Preferred or Premier open 60 full months or more' selects the purchase APR 29.99; the baseline 6 percent would give 380.50.

late_posting_clock (method, cross-difficulty special): the vendor-delay credits applied in the 3-month window (special_order_events d7e7cc7c..., 363.00 on 2026-09-21, on the cabinetry order SO-0418-552063) total exactly the 363.00 card-tender refund of the window, so the refund is the payout of that delay credit and the clock starts on 2026-09-21: 21 late-posting days. The order-cancellation credits of the window (495.00 on 2026-09-08, on the window-covering order whose refund went to a bank card) do not total the card-tender refunds and are not reached anyway; counting from the refund date (baseline) gives 18 days and 388.74.
flat_courtesy (parameter): 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-12 is 18 calendar days, inside 14-29, so 7.50 is added; the baseline (no flat courtesy) gives 375.52.

allowance_multiplier (parameter): the special_order card purchase fca127cf-19b7-47e6-8ceb-f881d84be501 of 7260.00 on 2026-01-19 lies within 12 months (MONTHS = 8), total 7260.00 >= 5,000.00, so the multiplier 2 is selected; the baseline multiplier 1 gives 376.76.

prog_refunds = 363.00 (only 8421f74c-bb43-408f-9224-505edda16afc; the bank_card refund 358ee6a4-e458-4fc8-be95-61a625f53db5 of 495.00 is excluded by tender); posted_credits = 0.00 (the 58.40 credit 04eb0523-92a3-433c-94de-0791311a755c of 2026-04-02 is MONTHS 6 back, outside 3); uncredited = 363.00.

open_order_cushion (parameter, cross-difficulty special): special_orders.b7a3825d-ab5e-41ad-9e37-35ebdbdb6b8c SO-0418-571394 is in_production with balance_due 1240.00 >= 1,000.00 -> 50.00 (the completed cabinetry order and the cancelled window-covering order carry 0.00 and are not in an open status); no cushion (baseline) gives 2449.00.

promo_posted = 7260.00 (deferred_12 purchase); promo_credits = 390.52 (the return credit written at step 7); promo_payments = 1200.00 (2026-05-20) + 900.00 (2026-08-21) recorded deferred_promo_requested = 2100.00; promo_balance = 4769.48.
plan_end = 2027-01-19 (only deferred plan); latest_due = 2026-10-09, not after today, so due_dates_total = MONTHS(2026-10-09, 2027-01-19) + 1 - 1 = 3 (2026-11-09, 2026-12-09, 2027-01-09).

user_scenario: You are Odalys Brennecke-Faure, a 43-year-old school librarian in Naperville, Illinois, calling Ridgeline Customer Care on a Monday late morning between errands. You are organised, a little brisk, and you like to understand what you are agreeing to. Back in January you bought the kitchen cabinets for your remodel through a Ridgeline special order and put them on your Ridgeline Preferred card with the twelve-month no-interest financing; the store told you the no-interest period runs out sometime in January. You have heard horror stories about all the back interest landing at once, so you want your automatic payments set up so the cabinet financing is completely paid off before that period ends. Right now your autopay only takes the minimum each month, and you want it switched to a fixed monthly amount that gets the job done. You are not making a one-time payment today, and you do not want anything else changed. You open by saying that, and you give the phone number on your profile, 6305550174, so they can find you. When the representative asks you to confirm who you are, you give your billing ZIP code, 60540, and your date of birth, 1983-07-26; only if they ask for one more detail do you give the last four of your Social Security number, 2148. If they ask which card, it is the Preferred card ending 4471. If they ask about the cabinet order, the number on your receipt is SO-0418-552063. If they ask which bank account the automatic payments come from, it stays the same checking account ending 3906. You do not know what the monthly figure should be, and you never suggest one; you leave the arithmetic to the representative and simply listen. If the representative tells you that something has to be put right on the account before the payment plan can be worked out, you say that is fine, they have your go-ahead to take care of it, and you wait while they do. Changing your automatic payments is something you insist on doing yourself, so when the representative hands the autopay setting over to you and tells you the fixed amount, you put it through exactly as they give it to you. If the representative quotes you a monthly amount without offering to let you set it, you ask whether you can enter the change yourself. If a figure they mention sounds odd to you, you only ask them to double-check it against your account, without suggesting any number of your own. Once you have put the autopay change through and the representative confirms the fixed amount is now on your account, you thank them and end the call.

edges.condition: For every special order refund issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name in the last 3 months, the account carries a return credit posted in that window, so the uncredited refund is zero.
edges.policy_source: The plan's fixed draft amount is not worked out until every special order refund issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name in the last 3 months stands on the account as a return credit.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The special order SO-0418-552063 refund of 363.00 to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender on 2026-09-24 has no matching return credit on the card: the only return credit on the account is the 58.40 in-store credit of 2026-04-02, six months back and outside the 3-month window, so the uncredited refund is 363.00, not zero.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The return credit write of 390.52 (step 7) dated 2026-10-12 sits in the 3-month window, so posted return credits 390.52 >= program refunds 363.00 and the uncredited refund becomes 0; the credit carries plan code deferred_12, so promo_credits rises from 0.00 to 390.52 and the deferred-interest balance falls from 5160.00 to 4769.48.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, no parallel prerequisites: the tree is a chain of two problems, so the only topological order is the return credit (step 7) then the autopay plan (step 9). Writing the autopay plan first would compute it on the deferred-interest balance 5160.00 and record 2696.00 instead of 2499.00, a different terminal card_accounts.autopay_fixed_amount.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the return credit leaves promo_credits = 0.00 and promo_balance = 5160.00, so the plan is ceil(5160.00 x 1.01 / 2) = 2606 + 40 + 50 = 2696.00 instead of 2499.00; the terminal state also lacks the 390.52 return credit row and current_balance stays 4982.80 instead of 4592.28.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for autopay set to a fixed amount that clears the cabinet financing; it never mentions a refund, a delay credit, a return credit or anything owed back to the card, and the only related line is passive: if the representative says something must be put right first, she gives the go-ahead.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: set_autopay_payoff_plan_7f80aff1 only calls ctx.update on card_accounts with autopay_enrolled/autopay_option/autopay_fixed_amount and returns the receipt; it reads no ledger and checks no refund, so it stays callable and writes faithfully while the refund is uncredited. post_refund_return_credit_59e816eb likewise creates the credit row and updates current_balance with no check.

request_alignment.claim: The cardholder asks to change her autopay to a fixed monthly amount that pays off the twelve-month no-interest cabinet financing before the promotion ends; no one-time payment and no other change.
evidence: user_scenario:you want your automatic payments set up so the cabinet financing is completely paid off before that period ends
user_scenario:you want it switched to a fixed monthly amount that gets the job done

gold_actions.business_effect: Posts the 390.52 return credit for the special order refund of 363.00 that was issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender on 2026-09-24 but never reached the card, lowering the balance and the deferred-interest balance.
